artifacts.summary: Confirms the dedup-before-track defect in deep_merge's plain-array branch, shows it also covers non-matcher hook-event arrays and a fourth stale record (email's permissions.deny) not named in the dispatch, weighs the three tracking-decision shapes and recommends shape (ii) plus a still-needed-by-another-loaded-extension guard, confirms [Regenerate] as the correct repair for stale records, and states the measured contradiction of the companion .dotfiles task's claim that seven of eleven sapience grants retract cleanly.

memory_candidates.content: finding is: lua/neotex/plugins/ai/shared/extensions/merge.lua's deep_merge plain-array branch dedups against the target array BEFORE recording anything, so a fragment item already present in the target is neither re-inserted nor tracked. manager.resync_all ([Reload All]/[Global Update]) calls manager.load(name, {force=true}) once per already-loaded extension without unloading first, so any such reload re-merges a fragment whose items are already present and overwrites that extension's merged_sections with an empty tracking record. The empty record is the expected steady state after one reload, not a one-off corruption. The defect also covers hook-event arrays whose blocks lack a matcher key (is_hook_event_array requires matcher on every block to route through the immune merge_hook_event_array path); mcpServers (object-keyed) and append_index_entries (unconditional per-path tracking) are not vulnerable.

finding is: manager.wipe (-> delete .claude/, keep project-root .claude-extensions.json state, -> manager.regenerate) is a mechanically correct repair for a stale/empty merge-tracking record, because regenerate re-loads every recorded extension into an empty target where the dedup-before-track check trivially passes and every item gets tracked. A plain [Reload All] (manager.resync_all, no wipe) does NOT repair staleness -- it is the mechanism that produces it.
